title: Shopify Products & Watchlist Reports
description: Catalog rows, coverage diagnostics and optional price/availability monitoring reports. Reports are produced only when live monitoring is enabled; they are not separate paid product rows.

runSummary.title: Run coverage and stop reason
runSummary.description: Saved products, failed requests, valid responses, spending-limit and pagination-limit indicators.

monitoringReport.title: Watchlist signals and history outcome (JSON)
monitoringReport.description: Optional monitoring counts, exact variant changes, coverage warnings and confirmed history save outcome.

changesCsv.title: Changes-only CSV (monitoring enabled)
changesCsv.description: Newly observed, changed and complete-scope not-seen signals, with spreadsheet-formula protection. All delivered products, including unchanged ones, remain in the billed dataset.

results.title: Shopify product records
results.description: Clean dataset items containing Shopify store product catalog, price, discount, stock, image, and URL data.
